relations: Arms extending upward from a lower open pose leads to both hands raised high overhead with open palms.
Slight rotation of the hips and torso shifts the stance from a wide back-facing position toward a side-on orientation.
The mirror reflects the dancer facing forward and smiling, with raised arms continuously tracking the foreground motion.
Sustained upper body shaping maintains the open, lifted hand posture throughout the mirrored room.
caption: The video captures a dance studio with white walls and a full-height mirror on the right, where ceiling lights, track spotlights, an air unit, and a metal rack are reflected. A person seen mostly from behind wears a red sleeveless top, a white tutu skirt, red leg warmers, red shoes, and a red-and-white Santa hat. The dancer's arms move upward from a lower open pose, with one arm extended and the other bent near the head, into both arms raised high overhead. The hands remain open and lifted as the upper body continues a slow, sustained shaping. The mirror shows the same person facing forward, smiling, with the raised arms tracking the foreground motion. The hips and torso rotate slightly, shifting the stance from a wider back-facing position toward a more side-on orientation. The camera remains fixed, and the raised-arm posture continues within the mirrored room.
